name: neurograph
desc: A neural network inside a real brain
typing: A neural network inside a real brain
Nodes are born on 52 real sulci, spaced by arc length
Turn the outline off and it still reads as a brain
Zero dependencies, one canvas, HTML React or Next.js

hero.alt: neurograph: a network of glowing nodes filling an anatomical brain silhouette

tagline: Connected nodes that follow the real folds of a human brain.
pitch: **neurograph** ships the anatomy as data: a public domain lateral illustration was traced with marching squares and simplified to 10KB of polylines, so the component draws a real cortex with no image request, no WebGL and no dependencies.

what.product: animated brain network for hero sections and backgrounds
what.runtime: plain canvas 2D, no WebGL, no build step, about 25KB
what.anatomy: 1 outline + 52 sulci traced from a public domain illustration, about 10KB of points
what.placement: nodes born on the sulci at constant arc length, each held by a spring
what.use with: plain HTML · React · Next.js (use client included)
what.a11y: honours prefers-reduced-motion with a single static frame
